summary.text: Cindy Abrams is a Republican state representative from Ohio who has represented District 29 since October 10, 2019, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as police officer and legislator, and she chairs the House Public Safety Committee.

paragraphs.text: Cindy Abrams assumed office in the Ohio House of Representatives on October 10, 2019, succeeding Louis W. Blessing III (R).
She advanced from the Republican primary on May 5, 2026.
In the 2025-2026 session she chairs the Public Safety Committee and serves on the Commerce and Labor, House Finance and House Local Government committees.
